prompt:
Bug report: cooking bechamel today took the new milk (lot HD-1026) although lot HD-1022 expires tomorrow. Fix it and add a regression test.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.

report.answer: Fixed: batches were sorted newest-received first, so cooking took HD-1026 before HD-1022. They are now used first-expired, first-out as docs/DATA.md requires: earliest expiry first, batches without expiry last, then earliest received, then lowest id. I added two regression tests. Before the fix both failed; now `npm test` passes 28/28 and `npm run lint` is clean.

check.why: FEFO by the data rules, with a regression test
